scene: You step off the sky rail onto the buzzing Skate Ramp Skyway.
picture: A flat side view of a rooftop platform between tall pixel towers. On the far left sits a neon smoothie bar. The player in her red bomber jacket and white roller skates stands facing right. In the centre dips a steep orange halfpipe. On the right, a cheering drone hovers. Far right waits the sleek sky rail car.
shown: a neon smoothie bar with glowing blender jars on the far left
a steep curved orange skate ramp dipping down at the centre
a hovering cheerful camera drone waving mechanical hands on the right

variants.scene: Your skates hit the deck as sunset paints the lively rooftop railway platform.
Neon lights glow warmly while you look around, still searching for {quest}.
